thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/10/2019: ERIC, TWTR, TSM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/10/2019: ERIC, TWTR, TSM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.65%
AAPL: -0.74%
IBM: -0.41%
CSCO: -0.72%
GOOG: Flat
Technology stocks were declining in pre-market trading Thursday.
Early movers include:
(-) Ericsson ( ERIC ), which was down almost 4% after the company said it will take a charge in Q4 stemming from its decision to accelerate the restructuring of its Business Support System (BSS) portfolio business.
(+) Twitter ( TWTR ) was up more than 3% after it entered a live streaming deal with the National Basketball Association (NBA) and Turner Sports.
In other sector news:
(-) Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( TSM ) was slightly lower after i t report ed revenue of NTD89.83 billion ($2.92 billion) for December, down a slight 0.1% from the NTD89.90 billion reported for the same period last year.
